negative_findings.description: No dedicated national petrol-station / fuel-retailers association website was located. Searches in Macedonian for a chamber group covering fuel retail returned only regulator (ERC) pages, market-share journalism about Makpetrol and OKTA station counts, and a chamber regulations page — not an association page with a member list or position papers.
negative_findings.result_summary: Fuel-retail sector appears to be represented inside the Economic Chamber's group structure rather than by a standalone association, but the specific група/здружение page was not identified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Petrol stations are a high-value, high-frequency card-acceptance segment and a habitual complainant on interchange/acceptance fees; missing this body leaves a blind spot in merchant-side friction evidence.

negative_findings.description: No national hospitality/HORECA employers' association with its own domain was confirmed. The only concretely named hospitality association page found was under the Macedonian-Bulgarian bilateral chamber (mabuko.mk); the Economic Chamber's own hospitality/tourism association page URL was not resolved this run.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Hospitality is the most cash-intensive acceptance segment; without its trade body, positions on cash limits and card fees in that segment cannot be tracked.

negative_findings.description: No association position paper specifically on card interchange / merchant acceptance fees or on cash-payment limits was found published by any Macedonian association during this run. The closest artefacts were the MBA statement on strong customer authentication from 1 March 2026, a general AmCham digitalization position paper, and press commentary that fee reduction is an individual decision of each bank.
negative_findings.result_summary: Fee-lobbying evidence exists as press quotes, not as retrievable association documents.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell's rationale expects quantitative claims and friction points from position papers; if these are not published, collection must pivot to press-quote extraction plus direct chamber document requests.

negative_findings.description: No Albanian-language (sq) searches were run in this slice; the run's declared languages are mk and en. OEMVP and much north-west merchant advocacy publishes primarily in Albanian.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A substantial share of the merchant population is served by Albanian-language business bodies; omitting sq systematically under-samples merchant friction.

negative_findings.description: Root domains for the Union of Chambers (chamber.mk), Business Confederation (bcm.mk), AFD (afd.mk) and the Foreign Investors Council (fic.mk) were inferred from search results, social pages or deep file paths rather than fetched directly in this run.
negative_findings.result_summary: Four candidate roots are plausible but not fetched; only deeper paths or third-party references were observed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The deterministic liveness pass must resolve these before they are treated as collectible; the FIC White Book in particular was only observed as a 2018 PDF.

negative_findings.description: mchamber.mk serves the same content under two URL schemes — legacy ASPX query strings (Default.aspx?mId=..&id=..&lng=1, and news by evid) and newer REST-like paths (/mk/home/zdruzenijainfo/{n}, /mk/home/grupacii/{n}). An archive subdomain arhiva.mchamber.mk holds older documents.
negative_findings.result_summary: Dual URL scheme plus separate archive host.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A naive crawler will either duplicate every page or miss half the site, and will silently drop the historical document set on the archive host.

negative_findings.description: The term 'комора' matches many professional chambers unrelated to banking or payments (e.g. Стоматолошка комора / dental chamber), and 'Стопанска' collides heavily with Стопанска банка, whose tariff and fee PDFs dominate results for fee-related queries.
negative_findings.result_summary: Two high-frequency false-positive clusters identified in Macedonian querying.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Automated query expansion on these terms will fill the pipeline with bank tariff PDFs and medical chambers unless negative terms are applied.

brief: North Macedonia's association layer for payments is anchored by three well-published bodies: the Macedonian Banking Association (mba.mk), whose member list resolves all banks and savings houses plus KIBS and the Credit Bureau and whose соопштенија carry dated sector positions such as the March 2026 strong-customer-authentication start; the Economic Chamber of North Macedonia (mchamber.mk), whose здруженија/групации taxonomy is the master pointer into trade, ICT, financial-organisation and non-bank-fintech member populations; and the ICT chamber MASIT (masit.org.mk), which resolves the POS/ATM and card-processing vendor set. The richest genuinely quantitative association source is the Macedonian e-Commerce Association (ecommerce.mk), which publishes payment-method-preference and online-fraud content that official statistics do not carry, complemented by AmCham position papers and the Foreign Investors Council White Book on the advocacy side and by ОПМ for consumer grievance about bank, ATM and card fees. The main weaknesses in this cell are structural rather than technical: merchant-side sector bodies for petrol retail and hospitality were not resolved to their own publication streams, no association position paper specifically on card acceptance fees or cash limits was retrievable (that argument currently lives only in press quotes), and Albanian-language chamber content — notably OEMVP in the north-west — is entirely unexplored under the run's mk/en language scope.
